set.body:
Events per term and cell per run; onset offsets relative to the parent trial (min/median/max) from EventPhase/PhaseRef; durations summary. Feeds the studio's events ribbon and one-trial view without app-side reconstruction.
Acceptance: matches the mock's ribbon for the five example studies.

Consumer: PLS Neuro native model studio epic (see the PLS Neuro integration ticket that names this id). General capability; no application-specific branches.
PLS Neuro spec: docs/plans/2026-10-02-model-studio-spec.md and docs/design/model-studio/ (branch studio/model-authoring-hillclimb, f8d32f0).
set.title: Per-term event and trial-phase summary
